comment: Internal tool name to CLI verb map (cli.md is canonical for verb names). Drives the rewrite discipline, the repo-local parity check (scripts/validate.py), and — at ship time — the connector tool naming. Internal names in the left column are BANNED from external skill text.

unresolved.screenshot_website: The Omni website lane screenshots rendered routes; the public website surface has no screenshot endpoint (v1 is static single-page HTML). Skills verify by reviewing the authored HTML and the published page, not via a CLI capture verb.
unresolved.close_website: Omni's open/close session bracket has no public analogue — the REST surface is stateless (create / set-content / publish are direct calls).
unresolved.upscale_video: Video upscaling has no public API endpoint (recorded parity exception). The CLI verb exists but fails with a typed not_available error; skill text must not recommend it.
unresolved.asset_search: `moda file search` now rides GET /v1/assets/search (Canvas Actions resource verb): `--kind icon` searches the shared icon packs, `--kind photo` (default) the caller's own gallery, returning durable file_ ids usable in markup and media inputs. Markup `<image icon="...">` remains the parser-native icon path. The broader files/folders drive facade (list/show/download, folders) has no public endpoints — those CLI verbs fail typed not_available.
